name: Orkim Berhad
overview: 2026年，Orkim Berhad 的公告主要涉及股息派发、公司秘书变更、地址变更及股东大会等事项，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订。
overview_en: In 2026, Orkim Berhad's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, changes of company secretary, change of address and general meetings; no expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract award was disclosed for any business segment.
